_comment: Trait definitions. category values: racial, habitat, role, unique, physical, personality, behavioral, acquired. inborn=true means present at creation (racial traits, congenital quirks). purgeable_by lists skills that can remove the trait via try_purge().

frail.name: Frail
frail.description: A fragile constitution, easily tired and slow to heal.

clubfooted.name: Clubfooted
clubfooted.description: An awkward gait that hampers quick movement.

quick.name: Quick
quick.description: Naturally fast reflexes and light feet.

hard_of_hearing.name: Hard of Hearing
hard_of_hearing.description: Weary of asking others to repeat themselves, they begrudgingly accepted their condition.

attractive.name: Attractive
attractive.description: A pleasing appearance opens many doors.

light_sleeper.name: Light Sleeper
light_sleeper.description: Sleep with one eye open, gripping the pillow tight.

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.description: The owl of wisdom flies after midnight.

hot_tempered.name: Hot-tempered
hot_tempered.description: Quick to anger, slow to forgive.

patient.name: Patient
patient.description: Once you endure the first impulse, you can wait almost indefinitely.

timid.name: Timid
timid.description: Easily frightened; prefers to avoid confrontation.

stubborn.name: Stubborn
stubborn.description: Hard to sway in any direction — for good or ill.

trusting.name: Trusting
trusting.description: Extends goodwill freely, perhaps too freely.

suspicious.name: Suspicious
suspicious.description: Trusts no one at face value.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.description: Always calculating what they stand to gain.

generous.name: Generous
generous.description: Gives freely, expects little in return.

melancholic.name: Melancholic
melancholic.description: A deep sadness runs beneath the surface.

vain.name: Vain
vain.description: Takes great pride in their appearance and reputation.

forgetful.name: Forgetful
forgetful.description: Details slip away; rarely remembers what was said.

gourmand.name: Gourmand
gourmand.description: Takes great pleasure in fine food and good company at table.

bird_lover.name: Bird Lover
bird_lover.description: Aren't those beady eyes just adorable?

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.description: Did you know most gamblers walk away from the table right before a big win?

storyteller.name: Storyteller
storyteller.description: Always has a tale ready — some true, most embellished.

collector.name: Collector
collector.description: Compelled to gather and catalogue curious objects.

superstitious.name: Superstitious
superstitious.description: There are no coincidences, only signs!

night_drinker.name: Night Drinker
night_drinker.description: When the sun goes down, the glass goes up.

paranoid.name: Paranoid
paranoid.description: Always watching. Always expecting the worst. Wait, did you hear that?

dreamer.name: Dreamer
dreamer.description: Feels more at home among the visions than the flesh.

fastidious.name: Fastidious
fastidious.description: Particular about cleanliness and order; unsettled by squalor.

haunted.name: Haunted
haunted.description: Disturbing memories surface at the worst moments.

war_hardened.name: War-hardened
war_hardened.description: Violence no longer shocks, only excites the senses.

grief_struck.name: Grief-struck
grief_struck.description: Carrying a loss that has not yet found its shape.

blood_handed.name: Blood-handed
blood_handed.description: Has taken lives that weigh on the soul.

oath_breaker.name: Oath-breaker
oath_breaker.description: Has broken a solemn vow. The weight of it is visible.

devout.name: Devout
devout.description: A sincere and practiced faith shapes every act.

lapsed.name: Lapsed
lapsed.description: Once practiced, now adrift. The forms remain but the heart has gone.

composed.name: Composed
composed.description: A hard-won calm. Seldom ruffled by what once would have stung.

enlightened_insight.name: Enlightened Insight
enlightened_insight.description: A rare flash of clarity left a permanent mark.

addiction.name: Addiction
addiction.description: Dependent on something — herbs, drink, or something stranger.

_comment_racial: --- RACIAL TRAITS — applied automatically via race starting_traits ---

hell_born.name: Hell-born
hell_born.description: Forged in the fires and torments of hell. Instinctively at home in its rabid violence and hierarchy.

serpentine.name: Serpentine
serpentine.description: A body built for water and coiling grace, equally at home in the deep as on land.

_comment_animal_realm: --- ANIMAL REALM TRAITS — habitat and archetype traits, applied via starting_traits ---

aquatic.name: Aquatic
aquatic.description: Born of the water. Breathes and moves freely in aquatic environments. If the entire party shares this trait, the party may traverse water tiles without penalty in both combat and overworld.
todo: water_tile_movement: grant party-wide water traversal when all members have aquatic

flying.name: Flying
flying.description: Sustained winged flight. If the entire party shares this trait, the party may traverse air tiles and elevated terrain in combat and overworld.
todo: air_tile_movement: grant party-wide air traversal when all members have flying

armored.name: Armored
armored.description: Dense natural plating — chitin, thick hide, or bone — makes this creature hard to put down.

predator_grace.name: Predator's Grace
predator_grace.description: The natural speed and precision of a born hunter.

colony_mind.name: Colony Mind
colony_mind.description: Born into a collective, this creature is never truly alone. Shared purpose dampens individual anxiety.

bulky.name: Bulky
bulky.description: A massive build that weathers punishment others could not survive.

venom_ward.name: Venom Ward
venom_ward.description: Generations of hunting venomous prey have made this creature resistant to poisons.
todo: poison_resistance: apply 50% reduction when combat system handles poison damage

nimble_mischief.name: Nimble Mischief
nimble_mischief.description: Quick hands and a quicker mind.

swift_wing.name: Swift Wing
swift_wing.description: Exceptional speed even among the creatures of the sky.

night_vision.name: Night Vision
night_vision.description: Sees equally in darkness and light, perceiving what others miss.
todo: darkness_immunity: no darkness penalty in combat when darkness system is implemented

undead.name: Undead
undead.description: The body is dead, or was never fully alive. Disease and poison find less purchase; the usual urgencies of flesh have gone quiet.
todo: disease_resistance: apply 50% reduction to disease damage/effects in combat system
poison_resistance: apply 25% reduction to poison damage in combat system

incorporeal.name: Incorporeal
incorporeal.description: Barely present in the physical world — more dissolution than body. Food, wealth and violence seem somehow exotic.
todo: physical_resistance: apply 50% reduction to physical damage in combat system

ancient_memory.name: Ancient Memory
ancient_memory.description: Long ages of accumulated experience have sharpened recall and insight. What others learn in a lifetime, this being has lived through many times over.

insatiable.name: Insatiable
insatiable.description: Mouth like a gate, throat like a needle.
todo: food_consumption: consume 50% more food per meal and rest
rest_healing: receive 50% less HP and MP from rest

better_starting_weapon.name: Armory Rights
better_starting_weapon.description: Some lives grant wisdom, others grief - this one grants you a superior weapon.

extra_starting_gold.name: Hoarder's Instinct
extra_starting_gold.description: Maybe they inherited it, maybe they've hoarded it by themselves - the important part is the weight of the purse.

content.name: Content
content.description: When you don't have what you like, like what you have.

oath_keeper.name: Oath-keeper
oath_keeper.description: Has held to a vow through the circumstances that made holding it expensive.

warm_hearted.name: Warm-hearted
warm_hearted.description: Easy to like, and easy about liking other people.

renunciate.name: Renunciate
renunciate.description: Has put down something they wanted badly, on purpose, and did not pick it back up.

merciful.name: Merciful
merciful.description: Has spared someone who could not have stopped them.

clear_eyed.name: Clear-eyed
clear_eyed.description: Sees what is in front of them without dressing it up.

celebrant.name: Celebrant
celebrant.description: Takes uncomplicated pleasure in other people's luck.

covetous.name: Covetous
covetous.description: Measures their life against other people's, and comes up short every time.

incurious.name: Incurious
incurious.description: At first, asking questions was difficult, then it became impossible.

grudge_bearer.name: Grudge-bearer
grudge_bearer.description: Forgets nothing that was done to them, and keeps the ledger current.

tea_ritualist.name: Tea Ritualist
tea_ritualist.description: The drinking is only the last part of the pleasure.

poet.name: Poet
poet.description: Composes constantly in their head, and occasionally, without warning, out loud.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.description: Prides themselves on never turning down a challenge.

braggart.name: Braggart
braggart.description: Improves the story a little every time it is told.

pilgrim.name: Pilgrim
pilgrim.description: The party schedule will wait, the shrine must be circumambulated.

debtor.name: Debtor
debtor.description: Owes money somewhere, to someone with an unusually long memory.

flirt.name: Flirt
flirt.description: Incurably charming, and worst of all at the least convenient moments.

homesick.name: Homesick
homesick.description: The farther away you are from your home, the easier it is to see it through rose-colored glasses.

early_riser.name: Early Riser
early_riser.description: Early bird gets to gloat when others wake up.

ascetic.name: Ascetic
ascetic.description: Eats little, sleeps hard, and wants less than the people around them.

mourner.name: Mourner
mourner.description: Keeps the dead's days. Leaves food out on the right nights, wherever they are.

gossip.name: Gossip
gossip.description: Knows everyone's business within a day of arriving anywhere.

scrimper.name: Scrimper
scrimper.description: Cannot part with money without a grimace.

beast_tender.name: Beast-tender
beast_tender.description: Good with animals, and they appear to know it right away.

sworn_vegetarian.name: Sworn Vegetarian
sworn_vegetarian.description: Will not eat anything that had a mother.

secret_bearer.name: Secret-bearer
secret_bearer.description: Carrying something they have told nobody, and have no plans to.

scarred.name: Scarred
scarred.description: The wound closed. The body it closed on is not quite the one they had before.

maimed.name: Maimed
maimed.description: Something is gone that used to be there. Warmth still seems to linger in the void.

death_touched.name: Death-touched
death_touched.description: Was owed to something, and was not collected. It has changed how they walk into rooms.

steady_practice.name: Steady Practice
steady_practice.description: Sits every night, whether or not the night deserves it.

mantra_worn.name: Mantra-worn
mantra_worn.description: Has said it enough times that it says itself now, under everything else.

ash_marked.name: Ash-marked
ash_marked.description: Has done the purification rites often enough to stop finding them strange.

bloodied.name: Slayer
bloodied.description: Has killed something that everyone agreed could not be killed.

sole_survivor.name: Sole Survivor
sole_survivor.description: Walked out of something that nobody else walked out of.

long_marched.name: Long-marched
long_marched.description: Has been on the road long enough to stop thinking of settling down.

touched_by_grace.name: Touched by Grace
touched_by_grace.description: Met something that had no business being kind to them, and was anyway.

harrowed.name: Harrowed
harrowed.description: Something happened. They have not described it, and are not going to.

beauty_struck.name: Beauty-struck
beauty_struck.description: Saw something that quietly reordered what they had thought possible.

drunk.name: Drunk
drunk.description: Past enjoying it, now it's just an everyday fact.

bhang_enjoyer.name: Bhang Enjoyer
bhang_enjoyer.description: Takes it only at the festivals - and isn't every day a festival of its own kind?

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Reads ground the way other people read letters. Knows what passed, how long ago, and whether it was hungry.

pet_lover.name: Pet-lover
pet_lover.description: Has never once passed an animal without stopping.

impaired_vision.name: Impaired Vision
impaired_vision.description: Struggles in the dark, misses details and enemies.
